title.narrative: QUALITAN: Quality standards and compliance programme for the United Republic of Tanzania

description.narrative: The EU supports Tanzania under the BEGIN Programme: #Support for Business Environment, Growth and Innovation#. The overall objective of the programme is to promote inclusive economic growth, employment and innovation, particularly among women and youth, and enhance consumer protection. The project proposal is under Specific objective 1 (SO2) of the BEGIN programme, with the aim to increase Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises# (MSMEs) compliance with quality standards to widen market access, reduce standards compliance costs, and enhance consumer protection. The main beneficiary is the Tanzania Bureau of Standards (TBS).
